from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd,json,re,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_cftc_treasury_position_source_qualification_v1';out=d/'sources'
protocol=json.loads((d/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));freeze=json.loads((d/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (d/'result.json').exists()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(d/'protocol.json')==freeze['protocol_sha256']
for rel,h in freeze['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(root/rel)==h
f=pd.read_csv(out/'2023金融期货原年档.txt',dtype=str)
name='UST 10Y NOTE - CHICAGO BOARD OF TRADE'
target=f[f.Market_and_Exchange_Names.eq(name)].copy()
assert set(target.CFTC_Contract_Market_Code)=={'043602'} and len(target)==52
fields=['Market_and_Exchange_Names','CFTC_Contract_Market_Code','Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD',
 'Open_Interest_All','Lev_Money_Positions_Long_All','Lev_Money_Positions_Short_All','Lev_Money_Positions_Spread_All']
target=target[fields].sort_values('Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD').reset_index(drop=True)
for col in fields[3:]:
 target[col]=pd.to_numeric(target[col],errors='raise');assert target[col].notna().all() and target[col].ge(0).all()
assert target.Open_Interest_All.gt(0).all()
assert target['Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD'].is_unique
obs=pd.to_datetime(target['Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD'])
assert (obs.dt.year==2023).all() and set(obs.diff().dropna().dt.days).issubset({6,7,8})
raw=(out/'历史特殊公布与延迟.html').read_bytes()
body=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser').get_text('\n',strip=True)
date_pattern=r'(?m)^((?:January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)\s+\d{1,2},\s*2023)\s*:'
matches=list(re.finditer(date_pattern,body));ann=[];delays=[]
for i,m in enumerate(matches):
 end=matches[i+1].start() if i+1<len(matches) else body.find('\n2022',m.end())
 text=body[m.end():end].strip()
 release_date=datetime.strptime(m.group(1),'%B %d, %Y').date()
 row={'announcement_date':str(release_date),'source_url':'https://www.cftc.gov/MarketReports/CommitmentsofTraders/HistoricalSpecialAnnouncements/index.htm','evidence':text}
 ann.append(row)
 scheduled=re.search(r'originally scheduled to be published on ([A-Za-z]+ \d{1,2}, 2023)',text)
 if not scheduled:continue
 planned=datetime.strptime(scheduled.group(1),'%B %d, %Y').date()
 assert planned.weekday()==4
 observed=pd.Timestamp(planned)-pd.Timedelta(days=3)
 explicit_available=pd.Timestamp(datetime.combine(release_date,time(23,59,59),tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))).tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')
 delays.append({'observation_date':observed.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),'normal_scheduled_date':str(planned),
 'actual_announcement_release_date_us':str(release_date),'supported_available_at_upper_bound':explicit_available.isoformat(),
 'calendar_delay_days':(release_date-planned).days,'clock_basis':'官方正文当日明确正在发行原定某日周报，保守美东当日末','source_url':row['source_url'],'evidence':text})
delay_df=pd.DataFrame(delays).sort_values('observation_date').reset_index(drop=True)
assert len(delay_df)==7 and delay_df.observation_date.is_unique
assert set(delay_df.observation_date).issubset(set(target['Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD']))
delay_df.to_csv(d/'7次实际迟报公布对齐.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
(d/'2023特殊公告原文提取.json').write_text(json.dumps(ann,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
target=target.merge(delay_df[['observation_date','supported_available_at_upper_bound','actual_announcement_release_date_us','calendar_delay_days']],
 left_on='Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD',right_on='observation_date',how='left',validate='one_to_one')
target['publication_clock_status']=target.supported_available_at_upper_bound.notna().map({True:'OFFICIAL_DELAY_NOTICE_DATE_UPPER_BOUND',False:'NORMAL_SCHEDULE_ONLY_ACTUAL_DATE_NOT_LOCATED'})
target['first_vintage_verified']=False
target.to_csv(d/'原10年合约52周字段与时钟资格.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
target.to_parquet(d/'原10年合约52周字段与时钟资格.parquet',index=False)
input_rel='reports/research/510300_multidim_financing_composition_v1/data_correction/monthly_score/月度事件联合状态及标签.parquet'
clock_events=pd.read_parquet(root/input_rel,columns=['stat_month','decision_at'])
clock_events=clock_events[clock_events.decision_at.dt.year.eq(2023)]
delayed={x['observation_date']:x for x in delays}
hypothetical=[];affected=[]
for row in target.to_dict('records'):
 day=pd.Timestamp(row['Report_Date_as_YYYY-MM-DD']).date()
 friday=pd.Timestamp(day)+pd.Timedelta(days=(4-day.weekday())%7)
 normal=pd.Timestamp(datetime.combine(friday.date(),time(15,30),tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))).tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')
 observed_at=pd.Timestamp(datetime.combine(day,time(23,59,59),tzinfo=ZoneInfo('America/New_York'))).tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')
 hypothetical.append({'observation_date':str(day),'observation_day_end_shanghai':observed_at,'hypothetical_regular_available_at':normal})
h=pd.DataFrame(hypothetical)
for event in clock_events.itertuples():
 for mode,column in [('将观察日当可得日','observation_day_end_shanghai'),('所有周次套普通周五规则','hypothetical_regular_available_at')]:
  before=h[h[column].le(event.decision_at)]
  if before.empty:continue
  chosen=before.iloc[-1];key=chosen.observation_date
  if key not in delayed:continue
  actual=pd.Timestamp(delayed[key]['supported_available_at_upper_bound'])
  if actual<=event.decision_at:continue
  published_delay=delay_df[pd.to_datetime(delay_df.supported_available_at_upper_bound,utc=True).le(event.decision_at.tz_convert('UTC'))]
  latest_explicit=published_delay.observation_date.iloc[-1] if len(published_delay) else None
  affected.append({'stat_month':event.stat_month,'decision_at':event.decision_at.isoformat(),'hypothetical_wrong_clock':mode,
   'would_take_observation_date':key,'official_release_date_us':delayed[key]['actual_announcement_release_date_us'],
   'official_available_at_upper_bound':actual.isoformat(),'latest_explicitly_published_delay_observation':latest_explicit,
   'evidence_type':'只定位确定迟报周的时点错配，不认证其他普通周，也不读取股票标签'})
pd.DataFrame(affected).to_csv(d/'原月度决策受迟报错配影响.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
(d/'月度时点只读输入回执.json').write_text(json.dumps({'input_path':input_rel,'sha256':sha(root/input_rel),
 'columns_read':['stat_month','decision_at'],'rows_in_fixed_2023':len(clock_events),'equity_return_columns_read':[],
 'actual_equity_returns_loaded':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
gates={'correct_contract_and_tff_futures_only':True,'weekly_coverage_explicit':True,'long_short_and_oi_complete':True,
 'publication_date_or_supported_upper_bound_for_each_observation':False,'no_observation_date_backfill':True}
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E7','completed_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
 'status':'SOURCE_GATE_NOT_PASSED_FULL_WEEKLY_PUBLICATION_CLOCK_NOT_LOCATED',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_FIXED_YEAR_FIELDS_AND_REAL_DELAY_CAUSE_IDENTIFIED',
 'accepted_facts':['2023原10年美债期货043602唯一定位，52周字段完整。','7次ION迟报可以用官方公告核对实际公布日末上界。',
 '其他45周只有通常日历规则，未在本次有限原文中逐周定位实际公布日。',
 '类别不是建仓原因，期货净空不是现金债卖出或基差套利规模。'],
 'annual_archive_rows':len(f),'annual_archive_columns':len(f.columns),'target_weekly_rows':52,'contract_market_code':'043602',
 'market_name':name,'first_observation':'2023-01-03','last_observation':'2023-12-26',
 'non_tuesday_observations':['2023-07-03'],'officially_rebuilt_delayed_weeks':7,
 'normal_weeks_without_individual_publication_clock':45,'maximum_delay_from_normal_scheduled_date_days':int(delay_df.calendar_delay_days.max()),
 'gate_components':gates,'strict_source_gate_passed':False,'limited_route_ended':True,
 'source_objects':5,'derived_extracted_originals':1,'special_2023_notice_records':len(ann),'delay_cause_roots':1,
 'affected_original_monthly_decisions':sorted({x['decision_at'][:10] for x in affected}),
 'affected_clock_examples':affected,'candidate_single_field_computed':False,
 'score_status':'NOT_RUN_FULL_PUBLICATION_CLOCK_GATE','account_status':'NOT_RUN',
 'historical_first_vintage_verified':False,'independent_validation':False,'equity_returns_loaded':False,
 'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'parameter_searches':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
(d/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(delay_df[['observation_date','normal_scheduled_date','actual_announcement_release_date_us','calendar_delay_days']].to_string(index=False))
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['accepted_facts','affected_clock_examples']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('受影响决策',json.dumps(affected,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
